theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.barSymJMSum_block_eigenvalue_zero_false {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (h2 : 2 ≠ 0) (q : K) (lam : Partition 0) :
¬∃ (ρ : Hecke K q q⁻¹ (0 - 1) →ₐ[K] Matrix (Fin (dLambda lam)) (Fin (dLambda lam)) K), ρ (barSymJMSum K q q⁻¹ (0 - 1)) = cellContentCoshSum lam q • 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.barSymJMSum_block_eigenvalue_of_pos {N : ℕ} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (hNpos : 0 < N) (lam : Partition N) :
∃ (ρ : Hecke K q q⁻¹ (N - 1) →ₐ[K] Matrix (Fin (dLambda lam)) (Fin (dLambda lam)) K), ρ (barSymJMSum K q q⁻¹ (N - 1)) = cellContentCoshSum lam q • 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.seminormalRep_barSymJMSum {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) :
(seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hN) (barSymJMSum K q q⁻¹ n) = (∑ c ∈ μ.cells, (q ^ (2 * cellContent c) + q ^ (-(2 * cellContent c)))) • 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.sum_cellOf_range {μ : YoungDiagram} {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) {n : ℕ} (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (f : ℕ × ℕ → M) :
∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f (TableauCells.cellOf T (k + 1)) = ∑ c ∈ μ.cells, f c

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.seminormalRep_qJMInv {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
(seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hN) (qJMInv K q q⁻¹ n k) = jmDiagValInv q (k + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagValInv_mul {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (v : ℕ) :
jmDiagValInv q v * jmDiagVal q v = 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagVal_mul_inv {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (v : ℕ) :
jmDiagVal q v * jmDiagValInv q v = 1

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagValInv {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (v : ℕ) :
Matrix (Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) (Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) K

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.seminormalRep_qJM {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (hN : μ.cells.card = n + 1) (k : ℕ) :
k ≤ n → (seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n hN) (qJM K q q⁻¹ n k) = jmDiagVal q (k + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.genMat_conj_jmDiagVal {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k + 1 ≤ μ.cells.card) :
genMat q k hk hkn * jmDiagVal q k * genMat q k hk hkn = jmDiagVal q (k + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.cellContent_succ {μ : YoungDiagram} (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) (k : ℕ) :
cellContent (TableauCells.cellOf T (k + 1)) = cellContent (TableauCells.cellOf T k) + TableauCells.axialDist T k

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagVal_one {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hcard : 0 < μ.cells.card) :
jmDiagVal q 1 = 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagVal_of_ne {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (v : ℕ) {T' T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ} (h : T' ≠ T) :
jmDiagVal q v T' T = 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagVal_diag {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (v : ℕ) (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) :
jmDiagVal q v T T = q ^ (2 * cellContent (TableauCells.cellOf T v))

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.jmDiagVal {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (v : ℕ) :
Matrix (Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) (Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) K

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.Seminormal.jmStep_diag {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) {d : ℤ} (hd0 : d ≠ 0) (hd : q ^ (2 * d) ≠ 1) (c : ℤ) :
seminormalParam q d ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * c) + SeminormalRep.offDiag q (-d) * SeminormalRep.offDiag q d * q ^ (2 * (c + d)) = q ^ (2 * (c + d))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.Seminormal.jmStep_offDiag {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) {d : ℤ} (hd : q ^ (2 * d) ≠ 1) (c : ℤ) :
SeminormalRep.offDiag q d * q ^ (2 * c) * seminormalParam q d + seminormalParam q (-d) * q ^ (2 * (c + d)) * SeminormalRep.offDiag q d = 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.Seminormal.seminormalParam_sq_mul {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) {d : ℤ} (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = -1) (c : ℤ) :
seminormalParam q d ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * c) = q ^ (2 * (c + d))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.Seminormal.seminormalParam_sq_of_neg_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) :
seminormalParam q (-1) ^ 2 = q ^ (2 * -1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.Seminormal.seminormalParam_sq_of_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) :
seminormalParam q 1 ^ 2 = q ^ (2 * 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.Seminormal.seminormalParam_weighted_cancel {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) {d : ℤ} (hd : q ^ (2 * d) ≠ 1) (c : ℤ) :
seminormalParam q d * q ^ (2 * c) + seminormalParam q (-d) * q ^ (2 * (c + d)) = 0
